title: NFC Patient Identification
summary: A web app with NFC stickers on patient bracelets for fast, reliable patient identification in hospitals, developed with the MADE Lab.
description:
We developed a web application, combined with **NFC stickers**, to make sure hospitals identify patients correctly.

- **A critical need** — confirming the patient's identity before giving medication or surgery prevents dangerous misidentification errors.
- **Smooth, reliable identification** — the NFC stickers go on patients' hospital bracelets, so staff can identify them quickly and reliably throughout their stay.

Developed together with the **MADE Lab**.
